text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby— A dream yearned for by 
countless Umamusume and their connections.

That crown, far too dazzling, drew in even 
those who once failed to grasp that dream.
—It has captivated me ever since.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I can feel an excitement even greater 
than at the Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list: It might be because of the other entrants.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Those are the contenders who passed on the 
Satsuki Sho. Last year's "Best Junior 
Umamusume," and...
(Clack... clack...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I look forward to working with you 
today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
――Ardan-san. It's a pleasure to work with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well then, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's have a great race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. May neither of us have any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well then!

Mejiro Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O. Yaeno 
Muteki's two rivals departed with few 
words exchanged.

"...The underground tunnel where footsteps 
have faded away. Filled with a taut, tense 
air, I'm frozen in place, hesitant to make 
even the slightest noise."

This tension was brought on by those two 
from earlier. A sheer intensity so 
powerful it felt suffocating.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Take a deep breath. You'll collapse if you 
keep holding it in.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's it, slowly breathe in... and 
breathe out...
choice_data_list:
I was holding my breath before I even 
realized it...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's no surprise, given how overwhelming 
that sheer intensity was.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I have experienced a similar tension 
through martial arts before."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In matches where they cannot afford to 
lose, like the representative races, 
everyone tends to project that kind of 
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To avoid defeat, we must overwhelm them 
with sheer spirit!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaa—h!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, my Lord Trainer. Let us take 
the field!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Chiyono O, Ardan—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(We have walked the same Classic Triple 
Crown path. That is precisely why I 
know...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(The feelings both of them have riding on 
the Derby...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I am prepared to risk life and limb for 
the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even if I burn out, I don't care.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The Derby... The Nippon Derby is the one 
race I will never give up to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll win for Maruzen-san's sake too!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—...However, it is precisely because I 
have honed my skills alongside both of you 
up until today...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to beat you all!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I want to go with you to the very end of 
our resolve!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The crown of the Nippon Derby will be 
mine!
